nodes.title: Mertens' theorem in arithmetic progressions

nodes.summary: For all natural numbers $n$, $q$ and $a$, the number $\pi(n; q, a)$ of primes $p \le n$ with $p \equiv a \pmod q$ equals the number of integers $p$ with $0 \le p \le n$ such that $p$ is prime and $p \equiv a \pmod q$.
nodes.title: Residue-class prime count as a filtered range

nodes.summary: For all natural numbers $X$ and $a$, the number $\pi(X; 1, a)$ of primes $p \le X$ with $p \equiv a \pmod 1$ equals $\pi(X)$, the number of primes $p \le X$.
nodes.title: Prime counting modulo one

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $X$, $q$ and $a$, $\pi(X; q, a)$ is the number of primes $p \le X$ with $p \equiv a \pmod q$. The modulus $q = 1$ is allowed, and for $q = 0$ the congruence means $p = a$.
nodes.title: Prime counting in a residue class

nodes.summary: Let $q \ge 2$ and $a$ be natural numbers with $\gcd(a, q) = 1$, and for each natural number $n$ let $N(n)$ be the number of primes $p \le n$ with $p \equiv a \pmod q$. Then $N(n) \log n / n \to 1 / \varphi(q)$ as $n \to \infty$, where $\varphi$ is Euler's totient function and $\log$ is the natural logarithm.
nodes.title: Prime number theorem in arithmetic progressions

nodes.summary: For every natural number $q$, every residue class $a \in \mathbb{Z}/q\mathbb{Z}$ and every real number $x < 1$, we have $\psi(x; q, a) = 0$, where $\psi(x; q, a)$ is the sum of the von Mangoldt function $\Lambda(n)$ over the positive integers $n \le x$ with $n \equiv a \pmod q$.
nodes.title: The residue-class Chebyshev function vanishes below one

nodes.summary: For a natural number $q$, a residue class $a \in \mathbb{Z}/q\mathbb{Z}$ and a real number $x$, $\psi(x; q, a)$ is the sum of the von Mangoldt function $\Lambda(n)$ over the positive integers $n \le x$ with $n \equiv a \pmod q$.
nodes.title: Chebyshev's function in a residue class

nodes.summary: Let $q \ge 2$ and $a$ be natural numbers with $\gcd(a, q) = 1$, and let $\pi(n; q, a)$ be the number of primes $p \le n$ with $p \equiv a \pmod q$. Then $\pi(n; q, a) \log n / n \to 1 / \varphi(q)$ as $n \to \infty$, where $\varphi$ is Euler's totient function and $\log$ is the natural logarithm.
nodes.title: Prime number theorem for the residue-class prime count

nodes.summary: Let $q \ge 1$ be an integer, let $b$ be a unit of $\mathbb{Z}/q\mathbb{Z}$, let $\Lambda$ be the von Mangoldt function and let $\varphi$ be Euler's totient function. For real $x$ let $\psi(x; q, b)$ be the sum of $\Lambda(n)$ over the integers $1 \le n \le x$ with $n \equiv b \pmod{q}$. Then $\psi(x; q, b)/x \to 1/\varphi(q)$ as the real number $x$ tends to infinity.
